Dear team,

Please be informed that we are currently experiencing an intermittent issue affecting our partner service. We are monitoring the situation closely and will provide updates accordingly.

For any assistance, please contact support@monnetpayments.com

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding.

We would like to inform you that the YAPE Peru withdrawal method is temporarily unavailable and is currently under review by our Technology team. We are working to restore the service as quickly as possible. We will provide updates through this channel regarding the progress of the investigation and will notify you as soon as the service is available again. Thank you for your understanding.

Resumen: A degradation in communication with the bank has been detected, resulting in intermittent service disruptions. As a precautionary measure, FINTOC has temporarily disabled the affected bank transactions until the issue is resolved and normal operations are restored. We are actively monitoring the situation and working with the involved parties to restore the service as quickly as possible. Further updates will be provided as new information becomes available.
